value.title: The Avengers
value.text: On the Helicarrier bridge, Hill asks when Tony became an expert in thermonuclear astrophysics, and he says it was the night before.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Avenger who claims he learned the Tesseract science overnight.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's deputy, who doubts Tony's Tesseract know-how.

verdicts.why: The exchange is real (Hill: 'When did you become an expert in thermonuclear astrophysics?' Tony: 'Last night.'). Only fix: the card line on Hill's card named Stark first, against house style.
Natasha brings Banner in for Fury's reactivated Avengers Initiative and works under him on the Helicarrier during the hunt for Loki. Boss fits between the Iron Man 2 and Winter Soldier stages.
Loki fatally wounds Coulson on the Helicarrier, and Fury uses his death to get the Avengers working together. Boss stays the same.
Coulson brings the Avengers file to Stark Tower, and Pepper greets him as 'Phil' and talks with him and Tony about the Avengers. Pepper is Tony's partner at this point.
J.A.R.V.I.S. places the call for Tony and Pepper misses it, so no exchange between the two ever happens. A missed call made on someone else's behalf is not dealing with each other.
In the theatrical cut Betty reports Peter's return to Midtown for Midtown News and cheers 'Go get 'em, tiger! Or, should I say, spider.' Classmates, so friend fits.
Dell greets Peter on his return ('We would love to welcome you back to Midtown High. Where we shape heroes'), and he and Harrington tell Peter not to listen when Wilson calls him a murderer.
Harrington greets Peter warmly, shows him the display case with their Venice photo, and tells him to ignore Wilson as a conspiracy theorist.
Dell and Harrington greet Peter together outside their classrooms and both tell him not to listen to Wilson. Fellow teachers, so ally stays.
Outside Midtown, Flash interrupts when a protester asks Ned who he is, calls himself Spider-Man's best friend and plugs Flashpoint, and Ned walks off annoyed.

Jameson reports from the destroyed condo that Spider-Man is to blame for the damage and May's death. Peter later calls in by video to admit he brought the villains and say he will be at the Statue of Liberty.
In the opening scene Happy goes back to check a noise, opens Peter's bedroom door and finds Peter and MJ, who came in through the window. Then they all watch the news report together.
May is called to the precinct and meets Ned and MJ, who were called in too. They pass Peter's room together before Cleary questions each of them.

Deever is an uncredited background agent at Cleary's interrogations, identified only by the actress after the release. She has no lines and no exchange with him, so nothing between them is shown in this title.

Mid-credits (credits scenes belong to their film): in the bar Eddie wants to go to New York to meet Spider-Man, Venom suggests skinny dipping instead, and Eddie is pulled back to his own universe, leaving a piece of the symbiote behind.

The facts are right: in the extended cut Betty interviews Harrington about being Peter's teacher, and he says his ex-wife now believes the Mysterio theories. Apply this stage only if the owner says yes to item 17 (it is not in the theatrical cut).

The facts are right: in the extended cut Betty interviews her history teacher Dell, and he tells her what he would be if he were Spider-Man. Apply this stage only if the owner says yes to item 17 (it is not in the theatrical cut).

The rules say only what is on screen and never mention alternate cuts. The More Fun Stuff Version is an official release that was shown in theaters, but it is not the standard cut, so the owner has to decide.
The actress confirmed it after release, but the screen never names her and shows no exchange with Cleary in this title. A silent background presence is not dealing with each other (see item 13).
The High Evolutionary orders Ayesha to bring him 89P13 or he will destroy the Sovereign. She follows the Guardians to Counter-Earth and sends Adam after Rocket at the Bowie.
Drax, Nebula and Mantis are captured aboard Arête, and the other Guardians, Groot among them, mount the rescue and fight the High Evolutionary's forces together.
Drax tricks Mantis into going after Quill. Stranded aboard Arête, she defends him when Nebula berates him, then calms three Abilisks that carry the three of them out.
Quill calls Kraglin in to rescue Nebula, Drax and Mantis from Arête. Afterwards he tells the Guardians he is leaving to go back to Earth.

value.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
value.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Groot, flies in to pick up Quill and Groot after they leap from the rising Arête with Theel.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian Gamora picks up after he leaps from Arête.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who picks Groot up after his leap from Arête.

verdicts.why: The event is right (Gamora rescues Quill and Groot after they jump with Theel), but this is the 2014 Gamora, who never met Groot. Every other Vol. 3 Gamora stage says so ('A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Drax/Rocket'), and that is also why the kind drops from friend to ally.

value.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
value.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Mantis, stays with her on Counter-Earth to guard the dying Rocket, until Drax talks Mantis into going after Quill.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian who stays with Gamora to guard Rocket.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager Mantis guards Rocket with on Counter-Earth.

verdicts.why: The event is right (Drax and Mantis stay with Gamora and Rocket until Drax tricks Mantis into following Quill), but this is the 2014 Gamora, who never met Mantis. The text now says so, as the other Vol. 3 Gamora stages do.
Escaping the Orgoscope, Nebula radios Groot to bring the Bowie. On Counter-Earth she drives with Quill and Groot in Neelie's car to Arête Laboratories.
Quill and Groot go into Arête, jump off the ship with Theel and take the override code from his body, and Quill uses it to save Rocket.
At target practice Kraglin loses control of the Yaka Arrow and stabs Nebula in the chest. Later Nebula radios him to lock Knowhere onto Arête so everyone can escape.
Quill leaves Kraglin and Cosmo in charge of Knowhere, then calls Kraglin to fly it to Arête and blast a hole in the spaceport for the rescue.
Aboard Arête Nebula insults Mantis, and Mantis says Nebula finds fault in everyone to make herself feel okay. In the pit Mantis calms three Abilisks that carry Nebula, Drax and her out.
On Counter-Earth Mantis stays with Drax and Gamora to protect the dying Rocket, until Drax tricks her into going after Quill's group.

value.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
value.text: Martinex picks Gamora up from Knowhere to bring her back to the Ravagers, where Stakar embraces her and welcomes her home.
value.on_a_card_about_b: His captain, who welcomes Gamora home to the Ravagers.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Stakar's first mate, who fetches Gamora back from Knowhere.

verdicts.why: Nothing puts Martinex at the Orgoscope boarding; Stakar alone briefs the Guardians there. Martinex appears only at the end, picking Gamora up from Knowhere ('Hey, Gamora. Are you ready?'), and then Stakar embraces her ('Welcome home'). The stage keeps only that.

Nebula keeps carrying the drunk Quill to his room, he touches her arm thinking she is Gamora, Mantis tells her 'He's your brother', and she stops Gamora when Gamora attacks him. Friend fits how close they now are.
Quill tells Kraglin they need his help to save Nebula, Drax and Mantis from the High Evolutionary, and Kraglin flies Knowhere to Arête and blasts a hole in it. That is acting for Mantis's rescue.

Post-credits (the scene belongs to the film): the new Guardians under Rocket, Groot and Cosmo among them, talk music, then charge together at a stampede to defend a settlement on Krylor. They are teammates on one small team, not just two people in the same battle.
